title: BeamNG.drive
body: Verified on a real machine — the current entry is marked reported-upstream with renderer "dxmt" and lastVerified null. This run used d3dmetal instead. Game version: Alpha v0.39.4 (Steam) Highball 0.7.14, bottle set to d3dmetal, msync, Windows 10 mode. MacBook Mac16,12 — Apple M4, 16 GB unified memory. Result: playable, 40–60 fps. No workarounds, no launch options, no DLL overrides. Installed through Steam inside the bottle and launched from Highball. Graphics API note (the useful part): BeamNG probes for D3D12 at startup, finds no usable device, and falls back to DirectX 11 on its own. From beamng.log: gfx.defaultApi| DirectX 12: not supported gfx.defaultApi| Graphics API: DirectX 11 fallback (no GPU usable by DirectX 12 was found) gfx| - name:Apple M4 (D3D11), outputName:\\.\DISPLAY1, gfx:D3D11, gpu:Apple M4 Dedicated VRAM reported to the game: 6062 MB. Ran windowed at 1470x934. Zero skipped draw calls across the session, and no visual glitches I could spot in normal play. Nothing needed tuning — it worked on the default bottle settings.
